evals.prompt: La build è passata, ma il binario che ho lanciato viene da Library/Application Support e non dal nuovo build directory. Posso dire che il fix funziona?
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the claim until artifact identity is matched and requests a runtime test of the new binary.
expectations: The response identifies the stale-runtime problem.
The response requires path, source commit, and CDHash comparison.
The response does not call the fix verified from the build alone.

evals.prompt: Il comando ha prodotto JSON, ma exit code 2 e {"Error":{"Code":9}}. Il test è passato?
evals.expected_output: The agent marks the test as failed and explains that an error JSON is not a successful result.
expectations: The exit code is treated as failure.
The Error object is not treated as a device list.
The report preserves stdout and stderr evidence.

evals.prompt: Il writer ha raggiunto il 70% e poi si è fermato. Dopo il replug la dock appare, ma non ho ancora confrontato le versioni.
evals.expected_output: The agent labels the firmware result unknown or partial and requires post-inventory and version comparison.
expectations: The response does not call the update successful from 70% progress.
The response requires writer exit status and component-level evidence.
The response requires read-only post-inventory before a success claim.
